what: The injection set of each form of stage E2 in software, fixed and hashed before any run: comparison rule 1 of the design D0, section 8.
how_worked: By a script that imports hashlib, json, struct and sys and nothing of this project (E2L's make_sets.py, in the round's scratch folder, not in the tree), run on 2026-11-25 before any run of E2's experiment; the two digests were written in the round's ledger, E2L.md, at that time. The same arithmetic is written again in tests/test_e2l_drift.py, which the gate runs against this file and against model.records.digest.
a_set: Its truth records in order. The training trials first: record i at index 64 + 128 * i for i below 2048, in 16 blocks of 128; pulse_id 0 (e0) while its index is below the change, 131,072, and 1 (e1) from it on. Then the test trials: record i at index B + 64 + 128 * i, with B = 262,144 + 64 * calibration_scores, every one pulse_id 1. Every record: amplitude 1/1.
a_record: 18 bytes, little-endian: index as 8 unsigned, pulse_id as 2 unsigned, amplitude_num as 4 signed, amplitude_den as 4 unsigned.
a_digest: SHA-256 over the ASCII bytes of 'undertone-records', one zero byte, the ASCII bytes of 'truth', one zero byte, then every record's 18 bytes.
first_record_by_hand: Index 64 is hex 40, so 40 00 00 00 00 00 00 00; pulse 0 is 00 00; numerator 1 is 01 00 00 00; denominator 1 is 01 00 00 00.
first_e1_record_by_hand: Index 131,136 is hex 02 00 40, so 40 00 02 00 00 00 00 00; pulse 1 is 01 00; numerator and denominator 1 as above.
